name: vue-draggable-monorepo
description: Drag and drop for Vue 3 and Nuxt: sortable lists, nested trees, kanban boards, multi-select drag and swap.
author: Nhữ Duy Thìn

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm verify && pnpm docs:check && pnpm --filter @stacklogs/playground run build && pnpm --filter @stacklogs/nuxt-draggable run verify:nuxt
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter @stacklogs/vue-draggable run verify:package && pnpm --filter @stacklogs/vue-draggable run verify:dist && node scripts/size.mjs --max-gzip 5120
